articles.title: Venezuela after Maduro: What Washington really wants
articles.summary: The article scrutinizes Washington's rhetoric concerning a potential military operation to remove Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro, urging separation of fact from fiction. It asserts that despite significant 'noise' about regime change, there is currently no active US-led regime change operation underway in Venezuela. The piece likely analyzes US foreign policy and the complexities of intervention versus diplomatic approaches in the region.
